dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Jean and Albedo once sat me down to have a serious discussion about whether or not the Spark Knight needed to take part in basic training like this.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: A knight's basic training helps build character, but since the Spark Knight's still so young... I decided to get her opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...She happily brought her bombs to the training grounds. And so, we reached a consensus: We won't discuss the matter again until she's a bit older.
